description: Free deep check of an email address, no sign-in needed: format, provider username rules, disposable and role addresses, and the domain's MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI records. Returns a report with a score (0-99, likelihood the address is real) and a verdict (likely_valid, risky, likely_invalid, unknown). Gmail, Outlook and other big providers skip DNS. No email is sent.
name: check_email
title: Deep-check an email address
